types.description: MCS 10-230/24 single-phase power supply, 185–265 VAC input, adjustable 24–28 VDC output

modelingNotes: Exact Murrelektronik article 85085, MCS 10-230/24; Murr preserves the job manufacturer label. Numbered terminals follow the exact circuit and historical front drawing, not connector-local PIN indices.

Input 185–265 VAC, 50–60 Hz; 2.1 A at 230 VAC; external fuse maximum 10 A. Output 24 VDC SELV ±1%, adjustable 24–28 V; continuous 10 A at +60°C or 12 A at +40°C (2014 sheet pp.1–2: https://dmliefer.ru/sites/default/files/documents/Murrelektronik/85085.pdf). Ranges and conditional currents are not assigned nominal voltages or per-terminal current limits.

Factory conductors join 4–5 (DC−) and 6–7 (DC+), shown explicitly in the exact circuit diagram. Represent these with explicit project jumpers. Function metadata never creates continuity; no DC−/PE or AC/DC net link is asserted.

Terminals 1 (class I protective earth), 2 (N), 3 (L) are required. Individual output clamps are alternatives and not universally required. Shared policy accommodates explicit fixed jumpers plus wiring; it does not approve multiple conductors under a clamp.

Front autorestart jumper is a local configuration interface, factory ON; individual pins/circuit undocumented and not modeled. LED and voltage adjuster are not signal terminals. Operating instructions English p.2, technical V1.2: https://se-import.com/documents/catalog/powering/murr/switch_mode/85085_ina_4_12.pdf

Current sheet calls clamps spring type; historical manual depicts screws and gives torque. Installed revision is unverified; no clamp construction/torque claim is encoded. Current 12 A UL label is not generalized beyond historical temperature conditions. No additional signal, communication, shield or separate bond point is documented.

connectionCoverage.notes: All seven numbered field terminals verified, including PE and duplicated output clamps. Local autorestart selector exists but its individual contact inventory/circuit is undocumented and omitted. No additional field interface is documented; installed clamp revision unresolved.
